description: The Flare Scoreboard collects community solar-flare forecasts and presents probabilistic predictions alongside solar imagery. It exposes forecast information through web displays and a documented JSON interface. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center. The verified page defines the resource scope; exact spatial resolution, time span and update frequency are not established by this review. The provider supplies a public web description. Licence and any software or data charges are unconfirmed and require provider clarification. The provider labels the implementation beta. Forecasts are submitted by participants and are not assumed to be independently verified. The resource can support infrastructure modelling; suitability for a specific simulation requires checking its inputs and assumptions. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
